reviews.text: We have worked with Tom and his team for the exterior painting of our house and also for the interior painting of our entire first floor after a recent renovation - in both cases, the work they did was exceptional!  We are repeat customers because it is an absolute pleasure to work with TB Painters - they are all incredibly professional, highly knowledgeable, and extremely hard working. They do an impeccable job and we highly recommend them!

I am a local realtor and Tom and his crew have done incredible work for my clients over the year. Everything from carpentry work, painting, trim and even building railings. I have personally used Tom in my own home as well. They are meticulous in their detail and most important trustworthy and honest on every job. Highly recommend!

Thank you Thomas and team from an old friend from years ago.  VHS ‘89.  My parents recently had their kitchen and adjoining room painted.  It looks awesome.  I’m home for a few days and see the craftsmanship and attention to detail that the team put into the job.  And my parents are old school and appreciative of the work.   Excellent work.  Highly recommended.  Thanks - Kris

TB Painters is always there for us, big task or small. A personal, artisanal job, done efficiently and fairly-priced to perfection … the opposite of the scarce attention (and frankly crummy work product) we used to get from the bigger shops we used to hire … until we met Tom.  For years now, all throughout our house, TB has been (and will be) our only choice.
